object_description: two height-graded building volumes forming a cohesive complex
design_condition: Two freely placed volumes form a spacious complex with the existing school, using differentiated heights and single-storey bases to transition pleasantly to the pedestrian level while creating varied outdoor areas.

positive.statement: The large building volumes are integrated well into the small-scale context by taking up the landscape qualities of the district.
Differentiated height grading and single-storey base buildings create a pleasant transition to the pedestrian level.
The independent architectural expression integrates the existing school and builds a strong identity as a cohesive public facility.
The central room is well lit and forms the heart of the school, with classrooms and group rooms arranged around it.
Flexible room dividers create surprising spatial constellations that support various educational concepts.
The outdoor areas offer a wide range of activities.
The allocation and design of pedestrian routes, deliveries and parking facilities are well separated for lessons and events.
The foyer and stage area extend the hall into an attractive space continuum open to its surroundings on both sides.
The two buildings have efficient supporting structures, low space requirements, robust materialization and a lean energy concept, supporting good economic efficiency.

negative.statement: The kindergarten outdoor areas are only partially visible from the rooms and are limited in size in some places.
The connection of the equipment room to the gymnasium via the corridor must be questioned from an operational perspective.
The dimensions of the stage access must be checked.
The sometimes high glass proportion and aspects of the interior design should be optimized in the interests of economy.
